Maintained Native CPU speech-token workflow for file/generative-route acceptance. Real PCM16 WAV decoding, authored log-mel extraction and prompt IDs feed an ONNX token head; silence emits world, nonzero audio emits hello. The one-pass token head publishes one token (no autoregressive-loop claim). Tokenizer transcript markers exercise the existing convenience prompt path. Geometry, class choices and dimensions are fixture data. Protocol streaming progress/cancellation is separately verified with a controlled driver event channel. This is functional evidence, not recognition quality.
